Subject: Your wrongful termination matter - Complaint No. 1730/2021

Dear Mr. Deshpande,

Thank you for meeting us on 21 April 2022 about your dispute with M/s Pai Pharma Ltd. As we understand it, the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. The matter is listed before the Thane Labour Court.

Our advice is to demand the domestic enquiry report and challenge it for breach of natural justice. Please collect the charge sheet, the enquiry report and the reply to the charge sheet and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹3,10,000.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
